warning.title: Test environment - Use fictitious data!
warning.body: This application is in a test and development environment and is not approved for processing real personal data. Please do not upload real personal or sensitive information. Instead, use generated test data for fictitious people.

notes.heading: How it works:
notes.categories: The redaction agent automatically identifies selected categories of personal data: names of natural persons, postal addresses, telephone/fax numbers, email addresses, dates of birth, personal identifiers (e.g. customer, insurance, tax numbers), payment information, and named identifiable function holders at specific companies, authorities, or organizations.
notes.images: Personal data in embedded images is not redacted.
notes.verification: The results must always be verified by a human review before the redacted document is processed further or shared. The AI can miss or misclassify content.

upload.dropZoneDescription: Please select a file or drag it into the designated area to perform automated redaction of sensitive content.
upload.formatHint: Supported format: PDF up to 100 MB
upload.fileTooLargeError: PDF files must not exceed 100 MB.

processing.heading: Redaction in progress ...
processing.description: {{filename}} is being processed. Sensitive content is being automatically detected and redacted.
processing.almostDone: Redaction is taking longer than expected. The process is still running.
processing.error: Redaction could not be completed. Please try again.
processing.highLoadTooltip: Processing may take longer during high system load because multiple AI workflows are running in parallel.

success.heading: File successfully redacted

confirmDialog.title: Redact new file
confirmDialog.body:
If you continue, your current redacted document will be discarded and can no longer be downloaded.

Make sure you have downloaded the file first.

success.downloadError: The redacted file could not be loaded. Please try again.
